symptom: Approved central blog render failed with 'Blogindex mist artikelen-marker' although the articles container exists.
root_cause: blog/index.html contains a literal backslash-n immediately after the articles container in the current production source, while the deterministic publisher only accepted a real newline.
fix: Accept exactly two known marker representations: real newline and literal backslash-n. Continue to fail closed for every other structure.
regression_guard: Never broaden to fuzzy insertion; the writer must still find the exact articles container and publish through the protected lane.
